name: Readymode
summary: Predictive dialler with compliance tooling and supervisor monitoring for high-volume outbound floors. Premium per seat, and predictive dialling carries real TCPA compliance responsibility.
best_for: high-volume outbound call teams (insurance, real estate, collections) with 5+ agents that need predictive dialing, compliance tools and supervisor monitoring
skip_if: you're a one- or two-rep operation (a simpler, cheaper dialer fits) or your outreach doesn't justify predictive-dialer speed and its compliance overhead
honest_knock: The per-seat price is premium, and the model rewards scale: the predictive dialer, compliance tools and supervisor monitoring earn their keep on a 5-plus-agent floor, but for one or two reps it's expensive for what a lighter dialer would do. Predictive dialing also carries compliance responsibility (TCPA and similar): the speed is only an asset if your calling practices stay compliant. For high-volume outbound teams, it's a genuine efficiency engine.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per license a month billed monthly or $199 billed annually
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-15 on readymode.com/demo/pricing-readymode/, the page titled 'Readymode Pricing and Flexible Plans'; first read at $239/$299 on 2026-08-17, after the vendor announced a price change effective 1 Aug 2026) Two published plans, priced per license per month, with a Monthly/Annual toggle: Starter $239 billed monthly or $199 billed annually, for 1+ licenses, and iQ $299 billed monthly or $249 billed annually, which the page calls ideal for 5+ licenses. The page labels the annual price '20% OFF' and says 'Save 20% when you sign up for an annual plan'; our arithmetic gives 16.7% ($199 is $40 below $239, $249 is $50 below $299; a 20% cut would be $191.20 and $239.20). Both plans have a one-license minimum. Both waive the set-up fee and the phone-number (DID) activation fee, both give free outbound minutes subject to a fair-use policy, and both charge inbound at $0.02/min. Starter includes up to 30 DIDs per license; iQ includes up to 75 and adds caller-ID reputation monitoring, assisted remediation, call cadencing, Autopilot and unlimited integrations, none of which Starter has. Implementation and training are included from 3 licenses. One complimentary Admin license comes with every plan, and the page is explicit that it is not an agent license — no floor plan, no web phone. Voicemail Drop is available only to those who qualify and costs extra per drop. Before 1 August 2026 $199 and $249 were the only published prices; since our 15 October reading the same two amounts are the annual rates. The ~$200 admin fee for sharing a license is not on the pricing page. On 7 October 2026 the short address readymode.com/pricing redirected to an old page titled 'TEST PAGE'; read from the Netherlands in a browser the price table did not render, so we read the served page.
